title: Confirmatory ImageNetV2 re-test of the heads at tuned learning rates and a common 20-epoch budget
description: User approved (2026-11-26, 'Yes, run re-test', answering 'Run the confirmatory ImageNetV2 re-test (84 runs, ~50 min)?'). Pre-registered before any run. Follows LR-001/LR-002 (validation only, seeds 42-44), which found lr 1e-3 too high for the dictionary heads and too high for the linear head, so earlier head comparisons (GRID-002, SEED-001, MSWEEP-001) are lr-conditional. This task re-measures the head comparisons on ImageNetV2 at tuned lrs. HEADS (4): sparse M2048 k512, sparse M4096 k1024, dense M2048 k2048 (all: Xavier fc, He encoder, CE + feature MSE 1/0/0 as ABL-001 abl-mse / SEED-001, Adam lr 1e-4, weight decay 0) and linear (Xavier, weight decay 1e-4, CE only, Adam lr 3e-4). COMMON BUDGET: every head trains 20 epochs at a constant lr with per-epoch reseeding; best.pt = epoch with highest validation top-1, then lower validation CE (selection on the seed's own 5k validation split, as all earlier tasks). Batch 128, cached GRID-001 features read only. The lr/epoch choice is LR-002's equal-20-epoch proposal (REVIEW-009 S-1): for the dictionary heads a post-hoc departure from the 10-epoch settings adopted by LR-002's rule, disclosed. LEVELS: source, 80, 90 (training images; matched-compression validation). SEEDS: 45-51 (7 seeds; each seed sets split, init and batch order; same splits as SEED-001/MSWEEP-001; not used for any lr choice). 4 x 3 x 7 = 84 runs. TEST: original ImageNetV2 matched-frequency (eval level source) once per run after training; the training-level ImageNetV2 score is also recorded (secondary, as earlier scripts). New wrapper src/run_retest.py; existing scripts unchanged; last.pt deleted; per-epoch history saved in done.json. PRE-DECLARED ANALYSIS (metric: ImageNetV2-source top-1 of best.pt; paired by seed; n = 7, df = 6; mean, sd, two-sided paired-t 95% CI, sign count, two-sided p). CONFIRMATORY FAMILY = exactly 12 tests. (A) Head comparisons, pooled over the 3 levels (per-seed mean of the per-level differences): A1 sparse M2048 - linear; A2 sparse M2048 - dense M2048 (sparsity at equal width); A3 sparse M4096 - sparse M2048 (dictionary size); A4 sparse M4096 - linear. (B) Compression cost per head, per seed: B1-B4 A(source) - A(L080) and B5-B8 A(source) - A(L090), for sparse M2048, sparse M4096, dense M2048, linear. Decision: 'detected' if the 95% CI excludes 0; 'meaningful' if detected and |mean| >= 1.0 pp (project tolerance). Holm-adjusted p over the 12 tests is reported alongside ('Holm-detected' if adjusted p < 0.05). WRITE-UP RULE for head claims (A1-A4): meaningful and Holm-detected -> state the difference as a finding; detected but not meaningful or not Holm-detected -> 'a small difference below the 1 pp tolerance or not robust to multiplicity'; not detected -> 'no detected difference'. Compression costs (B) use the same wording; a cost that is not meaningful means compression at that level retained accuracy within 1 pp for that head. Per-level head differences are reported descriptively with CIs (secondary, not in the family). PRE-DECLARED CHECKS: 84/84 runs; one split digest per seed, equal to SEED-001's digest for that seed; per head median selected epoch and the count of runs selecting epoch >= 19 ('budget binds' flag if median >= 19) or <= 2; instability count for the dictionary heads (total training loss rises > 5% between consecutive epochs, LR-001 definition). EXPLORATORY (labeled, not confirmatory): ImageNetV2 at the training level; top-5; per-head test gain over the earlier lr 1e-3 / 10-epoch runs on the same seeds and levels (SEED-001 seed-mse sparse/dense and seed-linear, MSWEEP-001 M4096); differences in compression cost between heads; agreement with LR-002 validation predictions. DISCLOSURES: ImageNetV2 has been evaluated on these seeds before at lr 1e-3 (SEED-001, MSWEEP-001), and repeatedly in the project, so it is not an untouched test set; k, init and linear weight decay were tuned at lr 1e-3 and are not re-tuned; parameters scale with M (capacity confound in A3/A4); selection by best validation epoch may favor flat curves; all heads use frozen ImageNet-pretrained ResNet-18 features (a downstream head claim, not learning from compressed data alone).
